name: sqrtm
expr: R = sqrtm(S); err = max(max(abs(R*R - S))); Ra = sqrtm(A); erra = max(max(abs(Ra*Ra - A)));
comment: Sig: R = sqrtm(A). Matrix square root for symmetric positive-semidefinite A via eig: R = V*diag(sqrt(eig))*V'. R*R = A to ulp. Extended in 2026-08 via Björck-Hammarling Schur algorithm for general real and complex matrices.
